recipe.visualDefinition: A high-angle, extreme close-up of a bald man's head, focusing on the texture of the skin and the curve of the skull, paired with a right-aligned, thin-weight typographic block separated by horizontal rules.
coreVisualRelationships: Dominant organic curve of the skull versus rigid geometric text block
Warm sepia-toned skin texture against a neutral, slightly desaturated background
Extreme high-angle perspective creating a sense of introspection and scale
Thin horizontal lines anchoring the text to the right edge of the frame
coreInvariants: Right-justified text block with underlining rules

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's head occupies approximately 70% of the frame, positioned centrally but leaning towards the left, cropped at the top and bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The crown of the head serves as the primary visual anchor due to its highlight and central position.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the curve of the skull from top-left down toward the sunglasses, then moves to the structured text block in the upper-right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the top-right corner to accommodate the typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep shadows and dark brown hair/accessories
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high contrast in values, emphasizing skin texture and specular highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and sepia

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for all text elements to maintain minimalist structure.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rules extending from the right edge to the start of the text

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric 70s soul aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary geometric purity and thin strokes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-angle, macro photograph of a bald man's head with warm brown skin. Focus on the texture of the skin and the curve of the skull. Include a hint of sunglasses and a thick chain at the bottom. Apply a heavy film grain and a warm, sepia-toned color grade. Leave the top-right corner relatively clear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned text in the top-right corner using a thin geometric sans-serif font. Each line of text should be underlined by a thin horizontal rule that extends to the right edge of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the perspective an extreme high-angle?
Is the film grain texture prominent?
Is the text right-aligned with horizontal rules?
Is the color palette restricted to warm earth tones?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure skin texture is not blurred by AI smoothing
Verify horizontal rules are perfectly straight
Confirm the high-angle perspective creates the intended scale
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro Portrait + High Angle + Grainy Sepia + Right-Aligned Thin Sans-Serif with Rules
